text: Training Center has teaching faculty with profound knowledge and rich experiences in the training of the Chinese Language.It offers effective training programs all the year round for those who wish to improve their Chinese Language proficiency. Students can choose classes at different levels according to their own levels. Class Level Class Name Schedule Objective Elementary Chinese I Elementary Comprehensive Chinese The class begins in September or February/March every year. For students knowing nothing about Chinese language, could learn more than 1000 words, make easy daily conversations with Chinese people and pass HSK Basic (Standard exam for testing Chinese language level) by the end of the semester. Elementary Reading Elementary Spoken Chinese Elementary Listening Chinese Practice Elementary Chinese II Elementary Comprehensive Chinese The class begins in February/March or September every year. For students who already have more than 1000 words or have learned Chinese for more than 400 class hours, they can learn more than 2000 words, have more complete daily conversations with Chinese people, and pass HSK Elementary-Intermediate by the end of the semester.
